test_title: PYST 20: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 13 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In March 2025, which anniversary of National Defence Day was observed to honour the sacrifices of India’s armed forces?
solution:
The correct answer is __**87th Anniversary**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **National Defence Day **is observed annually in India to** honor the sacrifices and contributions of the armed forces** in safeguarding the nation's security and sovereignty.
 
• The year 2025 marked the **87th anniversary** of National Defence Day, which traces its roots back to significant military events in **1938**.
 
• This day is dedicated to recognizing the valor, dedication, and commitment of personnel from the **Army, Navy, and Air Force**.
 
• National Defence Day also serves as a platform to spread awareness about the importance of a robust defense system in maintaining peace and security.
 
• Various ceremonies, parades, and tributes are organized across the country to commemorate the occasion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Armed Forces**

 
 
• India's armed forces consist of three main branches: the Army, Navy, and Air Force, along with auxiliary organizations like the Coast Guard.
 
• The **President **of India serves as the **Supreme Commander of the Indian Armed Forces**.
 
• India has one of the largest and most powerful military forces in the world, with a focus on modernization and self-reliance in defense production.
 
 
 
• **Historical Significance**
 
 
• The establishment of National Defence Day is tied to key milestones in India's military history, including contributions during pre-independence and post-independence periods.
 
• It is a day to remember the martyrs who laid down their lives in service to the nation.
 
 
 
• **Important Military Operations**
 
 
• India's armed forces have participated in several notable operations, including the** Indo-Pak Wars (1947, 1965, 1971, and 1999)**, the **Sino-Indian War (1962)**, and peacekeeping missions under the United Nations.
 
• They play a crucial role in disaster relief, internal security, and maintaining strategic stability in the region.
 
 
 
• **Key Military Institutions**
 
 
• India has premier institutions like the** National Defence Academy (NDA), Indian Military Academy (IMA), and Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** to train and equip its armed forces.
 
• These institutions contribute significantly to the development of military strategies, technology, and leadership.
